## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and does not include unrelated refactors.
- [ ] Public APIs and user-facing behavior are documented.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updates are included when needed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, generated artifacts, or private source are included.
